title: Learning to Tune with Biased Gradients: Iterative Feedback Tuning of Model-Free Control on Throttle Valves
abstract: arXiv:2611.06338v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Iterative feedback tuning (IFT) learns the parameters of a fixed-structure controller by stochastic gradient descent. At each iteration, two closed-loop experiments are run on the plant: the first one measures the tracking error, and the second one, driven by this error, provides the sensitivities from which the gradient of the cost is estimated. This estimate is unbiased for linear plants only. We study the biased case on automotive electronic throttle valves, whose friction and stiction vary between valves and runs, controlled by an intelligent proportional (model-free) controller, which is an incremental PI controller. We show that the mismatch of the controller state at the start of the two experiments, which stiction makes unavoidable, adds an error inversely proportional to the amplitude of the second experiment. On digital twins of ten valves, the IFT gradient is a descent direction in only 69\% of the low-cost region, friction

translated_title: 学习在有偏梯度下调参：节气门上无模型控制的迭代反馈整定
translated_abstract: 迭代反馈整定（IFT）通过随机梯度下降学习固定结构控制器的参数。在每次迭代中，需在被控对象上进行两次闭环实验：第一次实验测量跟踪误差，第二次实验由该误差驱动，提供用于估计代价函数梯度的灵敏度信息。该估计仅对线性对象是无偏的。我们在汽车电子节气门上研究了有偏的情形——节气门的摩擦与静摩擦在不同阀门和不同运行之间各不相同，由智能比例（无模型）控制器控制，该控制器是一个增量式PI控制器。我们证明，两次实验开始时控制器状态的不匹配（静摩擦使其不可避免）会引入一个与第二次实验幅值成反比的误差。在十个阀门的数字孪生体上，IFT梯度仅在69%的低成本区域内是下降方向，摩擦……
tldr: 该论文研究了迭代反馈整定（IFT）在汽车电子节气门这类非线性对象上调参时的梯度偏差问题，发现静摩擦导致的两次实验间控制器状态不匹配会引入与第二次实验幅值成反比的误差，且IFT梯度仅在69%的低成本区域内为下降方向。
en_tdlr: This paper studies gradient bias in iterative feedback tuning (IFT) of model-free control for automotive electronic throttle valves, showing that stiction-induced controller state mismatch between the two experiments introduces an error inversely proportional to the second experiment's amplitude, and that the IFT gradient is a descent direction in only 69% of the low-cost region on digital twins of ten valves.
